title: A Torus-Node Model for Emergent Spacetime, Gravity, and Gauge Structure: D4 Moves, Level-3 Commensurability, the S4 Ordered-History Algebra, and a Poisson-Source Interface
description: Lean 4 formalisation, the statement-to-declaration table, certificate records with their programs and stored outputs, retained calculation scripts, fixed outputs and interval fixtures for the torus-node model. The formalisation covers the finite algebraic statements represented in the released Lean modules; continuum and source-to-continuum interfaces remain conditional on the premises stated in the paper. Lean code and scripts are released under the MIT licence, while the documentation and numerical material is released under CC BY 4.0.
